name: set_uplink
summary: Point a Logic Rocket Uplink at a Logic Rocket Downlink, as screwdriver presses on its first button do; the uplink then reads that downlink's data network. Answers previous_downlink to set it back.

help.text: Only a downlink a press could select is taken: built and logic readable (describe_device on the uplink lists them in uplink.choices); anything else is invalid_downlink. The host sends the change to clients. Returns uplink, previous_downlink (its reference_id sets it back; null when it followed none) and link (as describe_device's uplink). Refused: not_uplink, invalid_downlink, not_host, device_not_found.

downlink_id.description: The Logic Rocket Downlink to follow, from describe_device's uplink.choices.
